name: MAST 3300
title: Oral History on the Working Waterfront
description: Introduction to the  working waterfronts of America, exploring their past, present and possible futures, along with the environments, industries and people that  make them up. Students will be introduced to the challenges and opportunities these spaces face and provide them with the knowledge and skills to conduct oral histories.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: MAST/MARN 1001; MAST 1200 or 1300E or 2101.
